discovery.label: Discovery
discovery.blurb: Find servers and channels, and the IDs most other tools need.

messages.label: Messages
messages.blurb: Read, search, send, edit, react to, pin, forward and delete messages, and manage threads.

channels.label: Channels
channels.blurb: Create, edit, move, clone, follow and delete channels.

permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.blurb: Inspect, set, copy and reset channel permission overwrites.

members.label: Members
members.blurb: List and search members, set nicknames, and kick, ban, time out or prune.

roles.label: Roles
roles.blurb: Create, edit, assign, order and delete roles.

screening.label: Screening
screening.blurb: Read and update the membership screening form.

forums.label: Forums
forums.blurb: Forum channels, posts, replies and tags.

webhooks.label: Webhooks
webhooks.blurb: Create webhooks and post, edit or delete messages through them.

scheduled_events.label: Scheduled events
scheduled_events.blurb: Create and manage events, see who is interested, and invite people to them.

invites.label: Invites
invites.blurb: List, inspect, create and revoke invites.

dm.label: Direct messages
dm.blurb: Send, read, edit and delete direct messages.
